The problem

You should not have to check whether the cleaners came

Most cleaning contracts fail the same way. The first month is excellent, the third month slips, and by month six you are the one noticing the bins.

Blancoz is built to stop that happening: the same cleaner attends your site each visit, works to a written checklist agreed with you, and sends a photo record when they finish. If something is not right, you call the owner directly, not a call centre.

Services

Cleaning services across Melbourne

Regular maintenance or one-off, tailored to the premises. Our goal is simple: your site is presentable, clean and hygienically safe for everyone who walks into it.

Commercial cleaning

Commercial cleaning

Scheduled cleaning for offices, government premises, hospitals and clinics, display units, showrooms, community facilities and childcare centres. Whether you need a service twice a week or every weekday, the scope is agreed in writing and worked to a checklist.

Industries we clean

We clean the places people have to trust

Different premises have different rules. Here is how we work in each.

Offices and professional services

Legal practices, architecture studios, creative agencies, co-working operators and corporate tenancies across Bayside, South Melbourne, Port Melbourne and Cremorne. Typically two to five services a week, out of hours, with a fixed cleaner so your team sees the same face.

Reference sites include a legal practice we have cleaned for two years and a creative agency we have cleaned for over a year.

Childcare centres

Childcare is the most scrutinised premises we clean and we build the service around that.

  • WWCC on every cleanerWorking With Children Checks on everyone attending the centre
  • Same cleaner every visitNo rotating strangers through the building
  • Photo record every cleanEvidence for your own compliance file
  • LHA licensedSo your engagement of us is answerable
  • Five days a weekSchedules worked around close of care

Medical and allied health

Consulting rooms, treatment rooms and allied health clinics. Clinical surfaces, contact points and waiting areas are treated to an infection-control routine agreed with the practice, and bathrooms and kitchens are sanitised every visit. We currently service a Bayside spine and sports clinic on a fortnightly cycle.

Owners corporations and building managers

Lobbies, common areas, lifts, stairwells, car parks and bin rooms. One point of contact, one invoice arrangement, and consistent standards across every building in your portfolio. We are happy to quote a whole portfolio rather than one address at a time.

Builders and developers

Final detail cleans before handover and site clean-ups before or after development, including skip and bobcat hire. We adapt to your build program and send photo reports so you can sign off without attending.

Your sector not listed?

We also clean government premises, hospitals, display units, showrooms and community facilities. Ask us.
